entities.summary: Coral Herrera Gómez is a Spanish feminist writer and communicator based in Costa Rica, known for her critique of the concept of romantic love and her contributions to queer studies. Coral Herrera was a writers & intellectuals from Madrid (b. 1977, Madrid). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
